# Project Instructions

This is an Angular e-commerce single-page application built with TypeScript and Angular 17+.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js (v18+) and npm installed
- Angular CLI globally installed: `npm install -g @angular/cli`

## Setup Instructions

1. Run `npm install` to install all dependencies
2. Run `ng serve` to start the development server
3. Navigate to `http://localhost:4200/`

## Project Structure

- `src/app/` - Application components, services, and models
- `src/assets/` - Static assets and data files
- `src/styles/` - Global styles

## Key Features

- Product listing with data from JSON file
- Shopping cart with add/remove functionality
- Checkout form with validation
- Order confirmation page
- Responsive design with CSS styling
